name: How Big, How Blue, How Beautiful

info.desc: "How Big, How Blue, How Beautiful" is Florence + The Machine's third studio album. It was released on May 29, 2015 on Island Records - 4 years after the release of the critically acclaimed second album, "Ceremonials" (2011). The album is produced by Markus Dravs (who has worked with Björk, Arcade Fire, Coldplay, Brian Eno, Mumford & Sons), and includes contributions from Paul Epworth and John Hill. A teaser trailer for the album was released on February 10, 2015. Describing the style of the new album, lead singer, Florence Welch, said, "Ceremonials"was so fixated on death and water, and the .

podcast.body: Florence took a year off between the *Ceremonials* album and this one due to a nervous breakdown, which was attributed to "too much too fast" and relationship issues, specifically a string of breakups and excessive drinking. "Florence had to take a year off between the Ceremonials album and how big, how blue, how beautiful, because she had a nervous breakdown of sorts, a case of too much too fast."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
